site.title: Tidemark Outsourcing | Back-office and support teams in Cebu
site.description: Tidemark Outsourcing hires and runs back-office and customer support teams in Cebu for accounting firms and online retailers.

data.title: Back-office teams in Cebu for *accounting firms and retailers*
data.lead: Tidemark Outsourcing hires bookkeepers, order processors and support agents in Cebu, trains them on your tools and runs the team day to day.

photo.alt: Four people at a wooden table on laptops, one with headphones

cards.title: Bookkeeping
cards.text: Month-end close, reconciliations and payables for accounting firms and their clients.

cards.title: Order processing
cards.text: Order entry, returns and refunds handled in your store admin.

cards.title: Customer support
cards.text: Email and chat replies written in your tone of voice.

cards.title: Data entry
cards.text: Invoices, forms and catalog updates checked against the source.

head.title: How a new team starts
head.lead: Most teams handle live work in their fourth week. You see each step before the next one begins.

steps.label: Week 1
steps.title: Scope and role profile
steps.text: We map the tasks, tools and volumes with your lead and write a role profile that you sign off before hiring starts.

photo.alt: Team lead mapping tasks on a sticky-note board with colleagues

steps.label: Week 2
steps.title: Shortlist and interviews
steps.text: Recruiters in Cebu test candidates on your sample tasks. You interview the shortlist and choose who joins.

photo.alt: Two people shaking hands across a desk after an interview

steps.label: Week 3
steps.title: Training on your tools
steps.text: New hires learn your ledger, store admin and help desk on copies of real work, with a reviewer checking each file.

photo.alt: Trainer presenting to a group in front of a flip chart

steps.label: Week 4
steps.title: Live work with review
steps.text: The team takes live work while a reviewer checks every item for two weeks, then samples a share each day.

photo.alt: Team member working at a desk with two monitors and a phone

data.title: Start with *two people* and your task list
data.text: We scope the role with you in one call and send a written plan the same week.

data.blurb: Tidemark Outsourcing runs back-office and customer support teams in Cebu.
